name: @pipeworx/mcp-mockdata

tools.name: generate_person
tools.description: Generate fictional person record(s) — name, email, phone, address, company, job title, birthdate, uuid — for testing/seeding (keyless, offline). All data is FAKE.

tools.name: lorem
tools.description: Generate lorem-ipsum placeholder text (keyless, offline). `unit` = words | sentences | paragraphs (default sentences); `count` = how many.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-mockdata forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the mockdata pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
